newsitem.title: USA: BPA offers 200 MW peak firm power for Tuesday.
newsitem.headline: BPA offers 200 MW peak firm power for Tuesday.

text.p: The Bonneville Power Administration (BPA) offered 200 megawatts of peak firm power for Tuesday pre-schedulings, compared with no peak firm offers for the previous day, the agency said Monday.
The power was priced at $18.00 per megawatt hour (MWh) for Northwest deliveries and $20.00 for California-Oregon border (COB) sales.
BPA's Tuesday price for firm power during light load hours was unchanged at $9.00 for both the Northwest and COB.

BPA increased Tuesday prices for non-firm power during hours ending 0100-0500 and 2400 PDT to $9.00 per MWh from $7.00-10.00 on Monday.. Non-firm power during hours ending 0600 and 2300 PDT was unchanged at $10.00.
